First public release of **NET-TOOLS**: 125 self-hosted network tools and troubleshooting
utilities in one web app, shipped as two Docker images for amd64 and arm64.

## Highlights

- **125 tools in 11 categories**: IP & addressing, DNS, connectivity, HTTP, TLS, email, BGP &
  registry, reputation, LAN, calculators, client diagnostics.
- **Three run modes**, shown on every tool: in the browser (nothing leaves your machine), on the
  server (its network vantage point), or through a public API with keys kept on the server.
- **Worldwide** measurements for ping, traceroute, MTR, DNS and HTTP through Globalping probes.
- **LAN mode** (Linux): Wake-on-LAN, ARP scan, mDNS and SSDP discovery, DHCP probe (rogue DHCP),
  gateway / NAT info (NAT-PMP, PCP, UPnP IGD, double-NAT detection).
- **Advanced server tools**: port scanner, iperf3, SNMP v2c/v3, IRR / AS-SET expansion (bgpq4),
  open relay test, URL / domain reputation, TLS cipher scan, browser ↔ server speed test.
- **Browser tools** such as the DMARC aggregate report viewer, JWK / PEM / SSH key converter,
  router config snippets (Cisco, Juniper, Arista, BIRD, MikroTik) and AS-path visualizer.
- Light / dark / auto theme with six accent colours, all checked for WCAG AA contrast.
  Shareable URLs, favourites, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> search, installable as a PWA.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/digibaro/net-tools-docker.git && cd net-tools-docker
cp .env.example .env              # optional settings and API keys
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
```

Open <http://localhost:8080>. Images:

- `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-web:0.4.0`
- `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-api:0.4.0`

Both come with an SBOM and build provenance. Configuration, profiles, API keys, LAN mode and
reverse-proxy setup are described in the [README](https://github.com/digibaro/net-tools-docker#readme).

## Security defaults

- The `public` profile (default) denies private targets and disables the port scanner, speed test
  and server info. SNMP and the open relay test are opt-in in every profile.
- Every target is validated and DNS-pinned. CLI tools run from an allow-list without a shell.
- Rate limits and per-tool bounds apply everywhere. Containers run read-only with only `NET_RAW`.

## Known limitations

- Mobile Lighthouse performance is 79 on the home page and 74 on tool pages; desktop is 99.
  Reaching 90 on mobile needs pre-rendering (planned).
- `METRICS_ENABLED` is accepted but no metrics endpoint exists yet.
- LAN mode requires a Linux host (Docker Desktop does not expose the LAN).
- SNMP was tested against an in-process agent, not yet against real devices.
